## Onboarding video pipeline
**Needs:** self-hosted n8n on the machine that has the repo + pnpm + ffmpeg + Playwright browsers (Execute Command is NOT available on n8n Cloud and is disabled by default in n8n 2.x: set `NODES_EXCLUDE=[]` on the n8n process).

1. Edit `REPO` in **Build command** (absolute path on the n8n host).
2. Pick Slack credentials + channel id in the 3 Slack nodes.
3. `curl -X POST <webhook-url> -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"id":"absence-request","youtube_url":"https://youtu.be/..."}'`

The webhook answers immediately; the run takes minutes. Add header auth on the Webhook node before exposing it.

nodes.name: Run pipeline
nodes.notes: Blocks until the pipeline finishes (minutes). Raise the workflow timeout in Settings if needed.
